title: The Riemann zeta function
description: A graduate course on the analytic theory of the Riemann zeta function: Dirichlet series, prime-counting estimates, the Gamma function and the functional equation, entire-function products, growth and zeros, the prime number theorem and explicit formulas, mean values, critical-line zeros and short intervals.
